title: Player Specific Keep Inventory
description: Only certain players have keep inventory.
body:
# Player Specific Keep Inventory

Ever had one specific person who does not play without keep inventory? Well, with this datapack, you can allow that person that luxury while you also have that threat of losing your loot!

## Usage

To use this datapack, simply download the datapack and use it in your world.
By default everyone will lose their inventory unless a player has the tag `pski.keepinventory`.

To make a specific person not lose their inventory run the following command:

```
/tag <player name> add pski.keepinventory
```

Repeat this until everyone required has the tag and you should be good to go!
